review:
The original submarine game that introduced xBomb. Four-row xNudge wilds gain +1 per nudge, xWays symbols reveal extra copies to add ways, and xBomb wilds blow away non-winning symbols on their reel while raising the multiplier.

Three bonus symbols give eight Silent Hunter Spins, where all three mechanics can combine. Extreme volatility, 55,200x max. It set the template for Das xBoot 2wei!.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
